notRunReason: A complete native Android gameplay journey was not verified. The October 8 Android 11 run passed native Party navigation, keyboard input and server-confirmed Join. Its waiting-room UI and settled landscape layout remained unverified at the fixed deadline.

attempts.name: Android16 first boot
attempts.observed: Android system watchdog repeatedly restarted system_server. Android later registered Chrome and Gboard. Root paused the attempt to remove resource contention.

attempts.name: Android16 quiet retry
attempts.observed: Android reached boot_completed=1 and launched Chrome133, but native system and SystemUI not-responding dialogs appeared. Chrome133 recorded SIGTRAP crashes and never exposed an app page or DevTools socket.
changesOnlyInsideAvd: Unused Google Search and Play Services disabled after repeated startup failures

attempts.name: Android16 host graphics retry
attempts.graphics: D3D12 NVIDIA GeForce RTX4080 via WSL
attempts.observed: Emulator reported GPU incompatibility and exited139 before ADB connected. The attempted ro.hw_timeout_multiplier property was rejected because only qemu.* properties are supported.

attempts.name: Android 11 AOSP fallback
attempts.observed: Android reached boot_completed=1. Official Firefox 157.0.1 installed successfully. Geckodriver first failed before browser launch while setting ownership on shared storage. The next attempt will use its documented internal storage mode.
attempts.laterObserved: On October 6, internal-storage WebDriver startup also failed, but native ADB launch loaded the Party page after adb reverse was restored. That screenshot did not establish a completed journey.
